skip_reasons: The CI runner has no native host C compiler for the optional recipe comparison.
Three CodeGraph installation checks require their Windows conformance fixture.

limitations: CI uses protocol and engineering fixtures, not account authentication or inference.
Optional tool and physical hardware access are not established by these jobs.
The prior Windows run exposed a returned-versus-persisted body mismatch; canonical storage and a regression test were added before this successful run.
The authenticated workflow exposed opaque Cornell input discovery; typed fields and scoped no-write regressions are included in this source revision.
Owned draft-note repair includes exact history, user-edit protection, lost-response replay, and interrupted partial-write regression coverage.
Five storage-cache regressions preserve same-size edited bytes with restored timestamps, paths and duplicate IDs, independent data values, invalid-input failures, and eviction beyond the count bound.
Scoped writer and inspection fixtures prove mechanics, interruption recovery and source capture integrity; the new operations still need actual account-backed end-to-end execution.
